blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.
blocks.zh: 模型合并旨在将从共同的预训模型中衍生出来的多个微调模型合并为一个单一的多任务模型,而无需额外的联合培训. 最近的光谱合并方法通过利用任务特定更新的低级结构来改进比简单的平均重量,但它们通常为每一项任务分配相同的等级能力。 这种统一的分配忽略了任务矢量可能具有多样的光谱复杂性,导致共享的合并空间被非最佳使用. 在本文中,我们提出了Spectraral Energy-Property Rank Group(SERA),这是一种简单的任务调整策略,根据每个任务矢量的单值能量结构来分配排名. 通过将更丰富的光谱容量分配给复杂或孤立的任务,并将较少的方向分配给紧凑的任务,SERA将基于SVD的模型从统一容量的合并扩展到依赖任务的能力分配. 标准视觉模型合并协议下的实验显示,SARA改进了多任务合并性能,同时保留了与现有光谱合并方法相同的总排名预算. 进一步的分析表明,任务一级的光谱浓度与适应性级别分配的每个任务效应密切相关,使人们能够深入了解空间研究局何时和为何有效。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a pretrained model into a single model. Instead of training a unified model from scratch on all downstream datasets, model merging reuses existing task-specialized models and aggregates their knowledge directly in parameter space. This makes model merging an attractive paradigm for building multi-task or more generalized models, especially in an era where a large number of pretrained and fine-tuned models are publicly available. By exploiting such models as reusable assets, merging provides a practical and efficient route toward model reuse without requiring access to the original training data or costly joint optimization.
blocks.zh: 模型合并旨在将从预先训练的模型中衍生出来的多个微调模型合并为单一模型. 模型没有从零开始对所有下游数据集进行统一模型的培训,而是合并了现有的专门任务模型,直接将其知识汇总到参数空间. 这使得模型融合了一种有吸引力的范式,用于构建多任务或更通用的模型,特别是在大量经过预先培训和微调的模型向公众开放的时代. 通过利用可重复使用的资产等模式,合并提供了实现模式再利用的实际而有效的途径,而不需要查阅原始培训数据或费用高昂的联合优化。

blocks.en: The success of model merging relies on an implicit geometric assumption about the weight space around a pretrained model. Since all fine-tuned models are initialized from the same pretrained weights, their task-specific updates are expected to lie in a relatively smooth region of the loss landscape [ 9 ] . Under this condition, interpolating or aggregating different task updates can preserve useful knowledge from each task while avoiding severe degradation. Another implicit assumption is that task knowledge is not entirely independent: the updates learned from different tasks are expected to be at least partially complementary or correlated. These assumptions explain why simple weight-space operations can often produce a merged model with non-trivial multi-task capability.
blocks.zh: 模型合并的成功依赖于对预先训练的模型周围重量空间的隐含几何假设. 由于所有经过微调的模型都是从相同的预先训练的权重中初始化的,因此预计其具体任务更新将位于损失景观相对平稳的区域[9]. 在此条件下,插入或汇总不同的任务更新可以保存每项任务的有用知识,同时避免严重退化. 另一种隐含的假设是任务知识并非完全独立:从不同任务中获取的更新预期至少是部分互补或相互关联的. 这些假设解释了为什么简单的权重空间操作往往可以产生一个具有非三角多任务能力的合并模型.

blocks.en: Early studies mainly explored direct weight averaging [ 29 ] . For example, model soups showed that averaging independently fine-tuned models can improve robustness when the models share the same initialization and training configuration. Later methods moved beyond naive averaging by considering the geometry of model weights or task vectors. Distance-aware strategies [ 12 ] attempted to account for the relative positions of fine-tuned models in weight space, while sign- or conflict-aware methods aimed to reduce destructive interference among task updates. More recent SVD-based approaches further introduced cross-parameter correlations by decomposing task vectors into structured low-rank components. These methods suggest that effective merging requires not only averaging parameter values but also preserving meaningful directions in the update space.
blocks.zh: 早期的研究主要探讨直接体重平均[29]. 例如,模型汤显示,当模型共享相同的初始化和培训配置时,平均独立微调模型可以提高稳健性. 后来的方法通过考虑模型重量或任务矢量的几何来超越天真平均. 远程感知战略[12]试图说明微调模型在重量空间的相对位置,而信号或冲突感知方法旨在减少任务更新中的破坏性干扰。 最近基于SVD的方法通过将任务矢量分解成结构化的低级组件,进一步引入了跨参数的关联. 这些方法表明,有效的合并不仅需要平均参数值,还需要在更新空间中保持有意义的方向。

blocks.en: Among these directions, SVD-based merging is particularly relevant because it provides an explicit way to represent task updates through singular directions. By projecting task vectors onto low-rank subspaces, such methods can capture dominant update structures while suppressing noisy or redundant components. DC-Merge extends this idea by constructing a cover space from task-specific singular vectors and preserving directional consistency through a structured masking mechanism. This line of work shows that low-rank structure and cross-parameter relations are crucial for improving model merging beyond independent parameter-wise aggregation.
blocks.zh: 在这些方向中,基于SVD的合并特别相关,因为它提供了通过单向表达任务更新的明确方式. 通过将任务矢量投射到低级的子空间,这些方法可以捕捉占优势的更新结构,同时压制噪音或冗余组件. DC-Morge通过从任务特定单向量中构建覆盖空间,并通过结构化的遮盖机制来保持方向一致性来扩展这一想法. 这项工作表明,低级结构和跨参数关系对于在独立参数汇总之外改进模型合并至关重要。

blocks.en: However, existing SVD-based merging methods still commonly treat all tasks as equally demanding. In particular, they typically allocate the same rank capacity to every task when constructing the shared merging space. This uniform treatment is simple, but it ignores the fact that different tasks may have very different structural properties in their task vectors. Some tasks can be represented compactly by a small number of dominant singular directions, while others require a broader set of directions to preserve their task-specific knowledge. In other words, task vectors may differ not only in magnitude or direction, but also in their intrinsic spectral complexity.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的基于 SVD 的合并方法仍然普遍将所有任务都视为同等要求. 特别是,在构建共享合并空间时,它们通常为每一项任务分配相同的等级能力。 这种统一的处理方法很简单,但忽略了不同任务在任务矢量中可能具有非常不同的结构属性的事实. 一些任务可以由少数主导单一方向紧凑地代表,而另一些任务则需要更广泛的一系列方向来保存其特定任务的知识. 换句话说,任务矢量不仅在数量或方向上可能有所不同,而且其内在的光谱复杂性也可能有所不同.

blocks.en: This observation motivates a different view of model merging: the rank capacity assigned to each task should reflect the structural complexity of that task. Difficult or isolated tasks may require richer low-rank representations in order to preserve their task-specific knowledge during merging. In contrast, tasks that are easier, more redundant, or more similar to other tasks may be sufficiently represented with a smaller rank. Uniform rank allocation can therefore be suboptimal because it may over-allocate capacity to compact tasks while under-representing complex or isolated ones.
blocks.zh: 这种观察促使对模式合并有不同的看法:分配给每项任务的级别能力应反映这项任务的结构复杂性。 困难或孤立的任务可能需要更丰富的低级别代表,以便在合并期间保留其具体任务的知识。 相比之下,较容易,较冗余,或与其他任务更相似的任务,可能以更小的级别得到足够的代表. 因此,统一军衔分配可能不够理想,因为它可能过度分配执行紧凑任务的能力,同时代表复杂或孤立的任务的能力不足。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a task-adaptive strategy for spectral model merging. SERA estimates each task’s rank demand from the singular-value structure of its task vector and reallocates a fixed cover-space rank budget accordingly. Instead of assigning the same rank to all tasks, SERA gives more spectral capacity to complex tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, improving capacity usage without increasing the total rank budget.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了光谱能量比例排名分配(SERA),这是光谱模型合并的任务适应策略. SERA从其任务矢量的单值结构中估计每项任务的排位需求,并相应重新分配固定的覆盖空间排位预算. SARA没有给所有任务分配同样的级别,而是给复杂任务更多的光谱容量,给紧凑任务较少的方向,在不增加总级别预算的情况下改进能力使用.

blocks.en: Our method preserves the benefits of low-rank SVD-based merging while extending it from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. It exploits cross-parameter correlations through singular-vector representations and requires no additional training data or gradient-based optimization, relying only on the task vectors available at merging time.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法保留了低等级的基于SVD的合并的好处,同时将其从统一能力合并扩大到依赖任务的能力分配. 它通过单向飞行器表示来利用跨参数的关联性,不需要额外的训练数据或基于梯度的优化,只依靠合并时可用的任务矢量.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We reveal that uniform rank allocation in SVD-based model merging overlooks the heterogeneous spectral complexity of task-specific updates, leading to suboptimal use of the shared merging capacity. 2. We propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation, a task-adaptive merging strategy that allocates cover-space ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector while preserving the low-rank nature of existing SVD-based merging methods. 3. We demonstrate that task-dependent rank allocation improves multi-task model merging and provide empirical analysis showing that the spectral structure of task vectors is closely related to the per-task behavior of the merged model.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1. 我们发现,基于SVD的合并模型中的统一等级分配忽略了具体任务更新的频谱复杂性,导致共享合并能力的利用不够理想。 2. 我们提议采用按任务调整的组合战略,按照每个任务矢量的单值能源结构分配覆盖空间的排名,同时保留现有基于SVD的组合方法的低排名性质。 3. 我们表明,任务依赖的级别分配改进了多任务模式合并,并提供经验分析,表明任务矢量的光谱结构与合并模式的每个任务行为密切相关。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Weight-space model merging. Model merging aims to combine multiple models into a single model directly in weight space, without additional joint training. Early studies showed that simple weight averaging can be effective when the models share the same initialization and lie in a compatible loss basin. Model Soups [ 29 ] demonstrated that averaging multiple fine-tuned models can improve accuracy and robustness without increasing inference. Fisher-weighted averaging further interpreted model merging from a Bayesian perspective and incorporated parameter importance through Fisher information [ 20 ] . Model Stock extended this line of work by analyzing the geometry of fine-tuned weights and approximating a center-close solution using only a few fine-tuned models [ 12 ] . These methods establish weight-space averaging as a practical mechanism for model reuse, but they mainly focus on global weight aggregation and do not explicitly model the heterogeneous structure of task-specific updates.
blocks.zh: 重量空间模型合并. 模型合并的目的是在重量空间直接将多个模型合并成单一模型,而无需额外的联合训练. 早期的研究表明,当模型共享相同的初始化并位于兼容的损失盆地时,简单加权平均可以有效. Model Soups [29] 证明平均多条微调模型可以提高准确性和稳健性,而不会增加推论. 费舍尔加权平均法从巴耶斯的角度进一步解释模型合并,并通过费舍尔信息纳入参数重要性[20]. Model Stock通过分析微调重量的几何学,并仅使用少数微调模型来近似中近解[12],从而延长了这一工作线. 这些方法确立了平均重量空间作为模型再利用的一种实用机制,但它们主要侧重于全球重量聚合,没有明确地模拟任务特定更新的多样结构。

blocks.en: Task-vector-based merging. Task Arithmetic [ 11 ] introduced the task vector, defined as the difference between fine-tuned and pretrained weights, and showed that arithmetic operations on task vectors can steer model behavior and compose multiple task abilities. This formulation has become a common basis for multi-task model merging. However, directly adding task vectors often suffers from interference among tasks. TIES-Merging [ 31 ] addressed this issue by removing small redundant updates, resolving sign conflicts, and merging only sign-consistent parameters [ 31 ] . AdaMerging instead learns task-wise or layer-wise merging coefficients using unlabeled data and entropy minimization, showing that different tasks and layers should not necessarily share the same merging coefficient [ 32 ] . DARE [ 33 ] proposed a drop-and-rescale strategy for delta parameters to reduce redundancy before merging [ 33 ] . Consensus Task Arithmetic (Consensus TA) [ 28 ] further localized task-specific information in sparse parameter supports and removed weights that are detrimental to multi-task fusion.
blocks.zh: 基于任务的合并。 任务算术 [11] 引入了任务矢量,定义为微调和预训重量的区别,并显示任务矢量上的算术操作可以引导模型行为,并构成多个任务能力. 这种提法已成为多任务模式合并的共同基础. 然而,直接增加任务矢量往往受到任务之间的干扰。 TIES-Merging [31]通过删除小的冗余更新,解决符号冲突,并合并仅与符号一致的参数[31]来解决这一问题. 相反,AdaMerging通过使用无标签的数据和最小化等方法学习基于任务或层次的合并系数,表明不同的任务和层次不一定共享相同的合并系数[32]. DARE[33]提出了三角洲参数的降级和调整战略,以减少合并前的冗余. [33]. 共识任务 算术(Consensus TA) [28] 在稀疏参数中进一步本地化的任务特定信息支持和去除不利于多任务聚变的权重.

blocks.en: SVD-based model merging. Recent spectral merging methods have moved beyond parameter-wise aggregation by exploiting the low-rank structure of task updates [ 27 , 19 , 8 , 34 ] . TSV shows that layer-wise task vectors contain meaningful singular directions and reduces interference by selecting and decorrelating task-relevant singular vectors [ 8 ] . DC-Merge further constructs a shared cover space from task-wise singular directions and preserves directional consistency during aggregation [ 34 ] . These approaches demonstrate that singular-space representations can capture cross-parameter correlations that are overlooked by flat task-vector operations.
blocks.zh: 基于SVD的模型合并. 通过利用任务更新的低级结构[27、19、8、34],最近的光谱合并方法已经超越了参数汇总。 TSV显示,层向量包含有意义的单向,并通过选择和装饰与任务相关的单向量来减少干扰[8]. DC-Morge进一步从任务单向构建共享覆盖空间,并在汇总过程中保持方向一致性[34]. 这些方法表明,单位空间表示可以捕捉到被平面任务执行者操作忽略的跨参数关联.

blocks.en: However, most spectral merging methods still use task-uniform or manually specified rank capacity, implicitly assuming that all task vectors require similar spectral budgets. This can be suboptimal when tasks have heterogeneous spectral complexity. Recent works have begun to address this limitation: AdaRank adaptively prunes singular components to reduce interference [ 18 ] , while PAVE purifies task vectors in a knowledge-aware subspace with spectral rank allocation [ 1 ] . In contrast, our work focuses on a complementary problem: allocating a fixed cover-space rank budget across tasks before directional-consistent aggregation. SERA requires no additional training data or gradient-based optimization, and reallocates the same total rank budget solely according to the singular-value energy structure of the available task vectors.
blocks.zh: 然而,大多数光谱合并方法仍然使用任务统一或人工指定的等级能力,隐含地假设所有任务矢量都需要类似的光谱预算. 当任务具有多样的光谱复杂性时,这可能不尽人意。 最近的工作已经开始解决这一局限性: AdaRank适应性地将单数组件推倒以减少干扰[18],而PAVE则在具有光谱阶次分配的知识意识子空间中净化任务矢量[1]. 与此相反,我们的工作侧重于一个相辅相成的问题:在方向一致的汇总之前,在任务之间分配固定的覆盖空间级别预算。 SERA不需要额外的培训数据或基于梯度的优化,而只根据现有任务矢量的单值能量结构重新分配相同的总排名预算.

blocks.en: Although this cover-space formulation provides an effective way to aggregate task-specific updates, its merging capacity is assigned in a task-uniform manner. blocks.en: We propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA) , a spectral model merging framework that adaptively distributes rank capacity across tasks according to their singular-value energy structure. The key idea is that different task deltas do not require the same number of singular directions to preserve their task-specific information. As shown in Figure 1 , SERA assigns more rank capacity to task deltas whose singular-value energy is distributed over many directions, while assigning fewer ranks to spectrally compact task deltas. This allows the merged model to use a fixed total rank budget more effectively by matching the cover-space capacity to task-wise spectral complexity.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Results of Vision Model Merging
blocks.zh: 5.1 愿景模型合并的结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate the proposed method as a general model merging approach under the standard vision model merging protocol. To ensure a fair and direct comparison with recent SVD-based merging methods, we follow the experimental setting of DC-Merge [ 34 ] , including the benchmark construction, backbone models, fine-tuned checkpoints, evaluation metrics, and baseline methods. The purpose of this experiment is to verify whether replacing uniform rank allocation with our task-adaptive allocation improves merging performance under the same merging budget and evaluation condition.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价拟议方法,将其作为标准愿景模式合并协议下的一般模式合并办法。 为了确保与最近的基于SVD的合并方法进行公平和直接的比较,我们遵循DC-Morge[34]的试验设置,包括基准建设、骨干模型、微调检查站、评价指标和基线方法。 这一试验的目的是核实用我们的任务调整分配取代统一军衔分配是否改善了在同一合并预算和评价条件下的合并业绩。

blocks.en: Following prior works, we conduct experiments in both parameter-efficient and full fine-tuning scenarios. For the parameter-efficient setting, we merge LoRA fine-tuned CLIP [ 24 ] vision encoders across multiple downstream classification tasks. For the full fine-tuning setting, we merge fully fine-tuned CLIP vision models using the same task collections adopted in DC-Merge. In both cases, we evaluate different CLIP backbones [ 24 ] , including ViT-B/32 [ 6 ] , ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/14, to examine whether the proposed rank allocation strategy generalizes across model scales.
blocks.zh: 继先前的工程之后,我们在参数效率高和完全微调的情况下进行实验. 对于参数高效的设置,我们合并了LORA精细的CLIP[24]视觉编码器,跨越多个下游分类任务. 为了实现全面的微调设置,我们利用DC-Merge所采用的相同的任务集,将完全微调的CLIP愿景模型合并起来。 在这两种情况下,我们评价不同的CLIP主干网[24],包括VIT-B/32[6],VIT-B/16和VIT-L/14,以审查拟议的军衔分配战略是否贯穿于各种示范比额表。

blocks.en: We compare our method with representative weight-space and task-vector-based merging baselines, including Weight Averaging [ 29 ] , Task Arithmetic [ 11 ] , TIES-Merging [ 31 ] , Consensus TA [ 28 ] , TSV-M [ 8 ] , Iso-CTS [ 19 ] , and DC-Merge [ 34 ] , depending on the corresponding fine-tuning setting. Since our method is designed as an adaptive rank allocation strategy for spectral merging, DC-Merge serves as the most direct baseline. In particular, we keep the total rank budget identical to DC-Merge and only change how the rank capacity is distributed across tasks. This allows us to isolate the effect of task-dependent rank allocation from the effect of using a larger merging subspace.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法与具有代表性的权重空间和任务执行器的合并基线进行比较,这些基准包括:加权算法[29]、任务算术[11]、TIES-Merging[31]、共识TA[28]、TSV-M[8]、Iso-CTS[19]和DC-Morge[34],取决于相应的微调设置。 由于我们的方法是作为光谱合并的适应性级别分配战略设计的,DC-Morge是最直接的基准。 特别是,我们保持与DC-Morge相同的总军衔预算,只改变军衔能力在任务之间的分配。 这使得我们可以将任务依赖的级别分配的效果与使用更大的合并子空间的效果隔离开来.

blocks.en: For evaluation, we report the average accuracy across all merged tasks. We also report normalized accuracy, where each task accuracy is normalized by the performance of its corresponding individually fine-tuned model. This metric reduces the influence of different task difficulty levels and allows a more balanced comparison across heterogeneous datasets. A higher normalized accuracy indicates that the merged model better preserves the task-specific performance of the original fine-tuned models. Overall, this evaluation tests whether our method can improve the average multi-task performance of merged models while maintaining the same experimental protocol and rank budget as existing SVD-based merging methods.
blocks.zh: 为了评价,我们报告所有合并任务的平均准确性。 我们还报告说,准确性已经正常化,每个任务的准确性都通过采用相应的个别微调模型而正常化。 这一度量法降低了不同任务难度水平的影响,并可以更平衡地比较各种数据集。 更高的常态准确性表明,合并模型更好地保留了原有微调模型的特定任务性能. 总的来说,这一评价测试我们的方法是否能够提高合并模型的平均多任务性能,同时保持与现有的基于SVD的合并方法相同的实验协议和排位预算.

blocks.en: 5.3 Analysis of Task-Adaptive Rank Allocation
blocks.zh: 5.3 任务分级分配分析

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Analysis of task-adaptive rank allocation.
(a) Energy concentration profile across tasks.
(b) Rank allocation ratio relative to uniform allocation.
Blue indicates fewer ranks than uniform allocation, and red indicates more ranks.
blocks.zh:

(a) 跨任务的能源集中情况。

blocks.en:
We analyze how the proposed method distributes the rank budget across tasks.
The motivation for task-adaptive allocation is that different task vectors can have substantially different spectral energy profiles.
If some tasks concentrate most of their energy in a small number of singular directions while others require many singular directions to preserve the same energy level, then uniform rank allocation can be inefficient.
blocks.zh:
我们分析拟议方法如何在任务中分配军衔预算。
任务调整分配的动机是,不同的任务矢量可以有实质上不同的光谱能量剖面.
如果有些任务将大部分能量集中在少数单数方向上,而其他任务则需要许多单数方向来保持同样的能量水平,那么统一等级分配可能效率低下.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 (a) shows the energy concentration profile of the 20 tasks.
The fraction of singular values required to reach the target energy varies widely across tasks.
For example, digit-related tasks such as MNIST, EMNIST, and SVHN require a relatively small fraction of singular values, indicating highly concentrated spectra.
In contrast, tasks such as Cars, Food101, and SUN397 require a much larger fraction, suggesting more diffuse spectral structure.
This supports the need for task-dependent rank allocation rather than assigning the same rank to every task.
blocks.zh:
图2(a)显示了20项任务的能源集中情况。
达到目标能量所需单数的分数因任务而大不相同.
例如,与数字相关的任务如MNIST,EMNIST,SVHN等,需要相对一小部分的单数值,表明光谱高度集中.
相比之下,诸如汽车,Food101,和SUN397等任务则需要更大的分量,表明光谱结构更加分散.
这就证明需要根据任务分配级别,而不是为每项任务分配相同的级别。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 (b) visualizes the rank allocation ratio of our method relative to uniform allocation.
Blue entries indicate tasks that receive fewer ranks than uniform allocation, while red entries indicate tasks that receive more ranks.
The allocation pattern aligns with the energy concentration profile: tasks with compact spectra receive fewer ranks, whereas tasks with diffuse spectra receive more ranks.
For instance, MNIST, EMNIST, and SVHN are consistently assigned fewer ranks, while SUN397, Food101, Cars, and DTD receive more rank capacity.
This provides empirical evidence that the proposed method performs spectral-energy-aware allocation rather than applying a fixed rank budget uniformly across tasks.
blocks.zh:
图2(b)可视化我们的方法相对于统一分配的军衔分配比率。
蓝色条目表示得到的排名少于统一分配的任务,红色条目则表示得到更多排名的任务.
分配模式与能量浓度特征一致:紧凑光谱的任务得到的排名较少,而分散光谱的任务得到的排名较多。
例如,MNIST、EMNIST和SVHN的军衔一直较少,而SUN397、Food101、汽车和DTD则获得更多的军衔。
这提供了经验证据,证明拟议方法进行光谱能意识分配,而不是在各项任务之间统一适用固定等级预算。

blocks.en:
Overall, this analysis explains why task-adaptive rank allocation improves merging performance.
By reallocating rank capacity from spectrally compact tasks to spectrally diffuse tasks, our method uses the same total rank budget more effectively and constructs a more balanced merging subspace.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,这一分析解释了为何根据任务调整的级别分配能改善合并业绩。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed a task-dependent rank allocation strategy for spectral model merging. Unlike conventional weighted averaging or uniform-rank merging, our method assigns rank capacity according to the spectral structure of each task vector. This allows complex or isolated tasks to use more singular directions, while compact or redundant tasks are represented with fewer directions. By incorporating task-wise spectral complexity, the proposed method preserves the benefits of low-rank merging while using the shared rank budget more effectively. Our experiments show that adaptive rank allocation consistently improves multi-task merging performance over uniform allocation, suggesting that effective model merging should consider not only how task vectors are aggregated, but also how much spectral capacity each task requires.
blocks.zh: 在本文件中,我们为光谱模型合并提出了一个任务依赖的级别分配战略。 与传统加权平均或统一等级的合并不同,我们的方法根据每个任务矢量的光谱结构分配等级能力。 这使得复杂或孤立的任务可以使用更单一的方向,而紧凑或冗余的任务则以较少的方向来表示. 通过纳入任务光谱复杂性,拟议方法保留了低等级合并的好处,同时更有效地使用共享的级别预算。 我们的实验表明,适应性等级分配不断提高多任务合并的性能,而不是统一分配,这表明有效的模式合并不仅应考虑任务矢量的汇总,而且应考虑每项任务所需的光谱容量。
